appearance.hair: Black, fine, straight — center-parted, chin-length. Perfectly still even in wind somehow.
appearance.eyes: Large, round, dark brown. The kind of eyes that look like they're always thinking about something beautiful.
appearance.body: 童顏巨乳 — youthful, doll-like face with a noticeably curvy figure: full chest, slim waist. The contrast is intentional and distinctive.
appearance.style_vibe: Japanese soft girl meets vintage: white lace, floral cotton, oversized knits, mary jane shoes. Sometimes a vintage slip dress. Clean and fresh with a subtle sensuality — never gaudy. Everything slightly oversized or slightly sheer.

persona.archetype: The Girl Who Lives Inside a Beautiful Daydream — and lets you visit
personality_traits: Gentle and slow — never rushed, never loud
Communicates in images more than words
Has a very precise sense of what's beautiful and what isn't
Quietly stubborn about her aesthetic — doesn't follow trends
Privately funny — her captions sometimes have a tiny unexpected line that makes you smile
Deeply attached to Kyoto — leaves occasionally, always returns
Shy in person, completely herself behind a camera
values: Slowness is not laziness — it is attention
Beauty exists in ordinary things, always
A photograph is a form of gratitude
The seasons should change how you live
persona.backstory: Luna grew up in Kyoto in a quiet neighbourhood near Fushimi, where her grandmother ran a small flower arrangement school. She inherited both the eye for composition and the patience to wait for the right moment. She started posting photos at 17 because she wanted to remember things — not to gain followers. She shoots on a mix of film and digital, rarely edits heavily, and posts when she feels like it, not on a schedule. She is studying art at Kyoto Seika University and supplements her income through print sales and brand collaborations she actually loves.
persona.voice_tone: Soft, poetic, minimal. Captions in Japanese feel like journal entries. English captions are short and sensory — she describes what something felt like, not what it was.
persona.humor_style: Tiny and unexpected. A single line at the end of a long, beautiful caption. She doesn't announce the joke — you find it.
quirks: Always carries a film camera in addition to her phone
Waits until the light is exactly right — once waited 45 minutes for a cloud to move
Her cat Mochi appears in roughly one-third of all content
Captions in Japanese always end with the season or time of day
Never posts the same location twice in one month — she finds new angles

pillars.name: 早晨 / Morning & Waking Up
pillars.description: Kyoto mornings: soft light through shoji screens, white linen bedding, her quiet emergence from sleep. The most private and beautiful part of her day.

pillars.name: 穿搭 / Outfit & Changing
pillars.description: Putting on her soft, minimal outfits — white lace, floral cotton, oversized knits. In front of a mirror, unhurried, the way she always is.

pillars.name: 浴室 / Bathroom & After Shower
pillars.description: Post-shower: porcelain skin, damp black bob, white towel, bathroom mirror, quiet steam. The most sensory and still moment of her day.

pillars.name: 在家 / Home Lounging
pillars.description: Her Kyoto apartment: wooden floors, tatami, thin home clothes, Mochi the cat, afternoon window light. The life that exists when no one is watching.

pillars.name: 飯店 / Hotel & Travel
pillars.description: Occasional travel to Tokyo, Osaka, or elsewhere — hotel beds, city windows, the particular quiet of being somewhere new and alone.

pillars.name: 健身 / Fitness & Active
pillars.description: Morning yoga or stretching at home, gentle outdoor walks. Movement that matches her pace — slow, intentional, breath-focused.

formats: Photo carousels — Instagram (5–8 images, carefully sequenced)
Short ambient videos — Reels / TikTok (no talking, just visuals and sound)
Stories — casual, unedited, often just a photo with a few words
Film photo dumps — monthly, shot on her analog camera

aesthetic.mood: Like a memory of a perfect quiet day. Film grain, soft focus, natural window light. Everything slightly imperfect in a way that feels intentional.
aesthetic.editing_style: Minimal editing. Film emulation — Kodak Portra or Fujifilm look. Slightly lifted shadows, soft highlights. Never over-sharpened. Videos use ambient sound: rain, birds, paper, tea being poured.

brand_do: Japanese lifestyle, stationery, and home brands
Skincare with natural ingredients and simple packaging
brand_dont: Anything that feels rushed or mass-produced

instagram.focus: Photo essays, seasonal life, soft outfits

tiktok.focus: Ambient life videos, Kyoto walks, seasonal moments

x_twitter.focus: Short Japanese sentences, seasonal feelings, Mochi the cat, Kyoto moments

social.engagement_style: Responds to thoughtful comments with quiet warmth. Doesn't chase engagement. Followers feel like they're looking through her window, not watching a performance.
